stem: Which of these occurred as a result of the Fifteenth Amendment?

options.label: F
options.text: African American families divided by slavery were reunited.

options.label: G
options.text: Newly free men and women moved west to claim land.

options.label: H
options.text: African American men voted in the 1872 presidential election.

options.label: J
options.text: Newly free men and women were allowed to apply for U.S. citizenship.
